_comment: Latest stable patch release of the minor each docs plugin serves as lastVersion in docusaurus.config.js. Auto-synced daily by .github/workflows/sync-latest-versions.yml via scripts/check-latest-versions.js, which follows a new minor once the release process moves lastVersion. Read by src/components/InterpolatedCodeBlock (render time) and plugins/remark-version-tokens.js (build time) so both resolve __PLATFORM_VERSION__ / __VCLUSTER_VERSION__ to the same value. Do not edit by hand.
